name: Shinobu - Tsukikage no Meikyuu
source:
Sengoku. One day Huaga clan scrolls get stolen by Saiga clan. Three Huaga clan shinobi were sent to recover the scrolls, but failed. Now a legendary ninja exiled from the Huaga clan in the past is requested to take up the task.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
战国时代。一天，羽贺一族的卷轴被杂贺一族盗走。羽贺一族派出三名忍者取回卷轴，却以失败告终。如今，他们请来一位曾被羽贺一族放逐的传奇忍者，接下这项任务。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
